$comment: Which changed paths a RockWeb artifact can absorb without being rebuilt.
Read by Get-ArtifactPlan.ps1 (should this run build?) and by
New-RepackagedArtifact.ps1 (patch a base artifact instead). Both read this one
file so the decision and the patch cannot disagree about a path.
Rules are tried in order and the first match wins. A path no rule matches is
build-class: an unknown path costs a 27-minute build, a wrongly patched one ships
source where compiled output belongs. Matching is case-insensitive because IIS is.
build   the build writes or rewrites this path, so the base artifact's copy
is compiled output and the checkout's copy is not a substitute.
patch   copied into the artifact verbatim by the build, so the checkout's copy
is exactly what a build would have shipped.
ignore  never reaches the artifact at all.
{GeneratedTheme} expands to every directory under Rock.Frontend.Styles/src/themes,
read from the tree at run time rather than listed here.
